name: The Great Cat Spirit
summary: Dendrite Starblaze calls you to Moonglade for the next step in your druidic training. He sets you on the path to learn nature’s cat perspective.

sections.title: A Call to Moonglade
sections.body: Dendrite Starblaze seeks you in Nighthaven, the village in Moonglade. You have already learned the magic that brings you there, and your druidic training can continue when you meet him.

sections.title: The Cat’s Perspective
sections.body: Dendrite welcomes you back and turns your training toward the cat, another perspective of nature. As with the bear, understanding this aspect rests with you.

faq.answer: Dendrite Starblaze has sent for you in Nighthaven, Moonglade.

faq.q: What does Dendrite want to teach me?
faq.answer: Dendrite will set you on the path to understanding the cat as a perspective of nature.
Dendrite is in the village of Nighthaven in Moonglade.
You have already learned the magic that takes you to Moonglade.
You have already learned the magic to travel to Moonglade, and Dendrite compares this learning to the bear aspect.

angles.text: As a druid, Dendrite’s teaching opens the next part of your training: understanding nature through the cat.

attribution: In-game quest text: The Great Cat Spirit
